name: Ahmad Iskandar
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport marketing began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Communications from Universiti Sains Malaysia, he initially worked in advertising for consumer goods. A chance encounter at the Sepang International Circuit sparked a passion that led him to volunteer at local racing events. He quickly rose through the ranks, proving adept at crafting compelling narratives around teams and drivers. 

His approach to marketing is rooted in authenticity and deep understanding of the target audience. Ahmad believes in building strong relationships with fans and sponsors alike, focusing on creating engaging content that highlights the human element of racing. He's known for his calm demeanor and ability to think strategically under pressure, making him a valuable asset in the high-stakes world of motorsport marketing. He is particularly skilled at identifying and leveraging emerging trends in digital marketing to maximize reach and impact.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down marketing ideas, even in meetings.
Has a lucky batik shirt he wears for important race weekends.
Prefers to communicate via handwritten notes for internal memos.
